text: The combination of a large ovarian mass, ascites, and pleural effusion with normal CA-125 levels strongly suggests Meigs' syndrome, typically caused by an ovarian fibroma. I will request images to confirm the solid nature of the tumor and rule out malignancy. REQUEST IMAGES
